claims.paper_rule: Methods: training 4th-percentile log-return labels and causal 59-minute proposed features
claims.runtime_rule: Prior minute changes, peak curvature/height regression and last-six-to-all-window change ratio

claims.paper_rule: Methods: training-only standardization, mixture estimation and BIC model selection
claims.runtime_rule: EM diagonal covariance with declared .001 ridge; select K=1..4 by exact diagonal-model BIC

claims.paper_rule: Methods: classify buy/sell/hold within similarly clustered market trends
claims.runtime_rule: One-nearest-neighbor bank per selected mixture cluster; trade predicted minute60 then flatten

differences: Single public Binance BTC market replaces OKX BTC/PEPE and Nasdaq sources.
Jan-Feb2024 training, March diagnostic validation and fixed April-May test replace original six-month three-market experiments.
Diagonal covariance and K=1..4 grid are declared; paper does not give all estimator settings.
Feature text says six tail values but indices53..59 contain seven; choose exactly six, with a dedicated oracle.
Degenerate/no-peak regression uses an explicit zero slope and local mean feature convention.
KNN only; RF, DNN, SVM, XGBoost, random benchmark and original APC profitability reproduction excluded.
Validation reports per-class support, recall and a hold baseline; it cannot alter labels, scaler, GMM or neighbors.
reproduction_scope: bounded local method adaptation; not full paper experiment

source.title: Combining supervised and unsupervised learning methods to predict financial market movements
